title: Pest Control Local Services Ads: 6 Problems and Fixes

facts.fact: Google's help page says it no longer supports credits for 'job type not serviced' and 'geo not serviced' leads.
facts.quote: Google’s help page says it no longer supports credits for “job type not serviced” and “geo not serviced” leads

facts.fact: Elevarus (May 8, 2026) says wildlife accounts often run above 50% non-target calls in operator reports.
facts.quote: wildlife accounts often run above 50% non-target calls in operator reports.

facts.fact: One owner's account, relayed by PipelineOn (May 28, 2026) and not verified by the page author, says 15 of 23 recent leads were bird, squirrel or raccoon calls at about $80 each.
facts.quote: 15 of 23 recent leads were bird, squirrel or raccoon calls at about $80 each

facts.fact: Elevarus estimates the cost per booked job at roughly double to quadruple the headline cost per lead.
facts.quote: Elevarus estimates the booked-job cost at roughly double to quadruple the headline cost.

facts.fact: In an Elevarus worked example, $4,000 bought 110 billable calls at $36 each and 38 booked jobs at about $105 each.
facts.quote: In its worked example, $4,000 bought 110 billable calls at $36 each, and 38 booked jobs at about $105 each.

facts.fact: Google may refund some billed leads on its own, usually within 30 days.
facts.quote: Google may refund some on its own, usually within 30 days.

facts.fact: Cube Creative's example is a $2,000 monthly budget at $40 per lead, about 50 leads, which falls to about 35 in June when every competitor bids.
facts.quote: Cube Creative’s example is $2,000 at $40 a lead, about 50 leads, which falls to about 35 in June when every competitor bids.

facts.fact: Cube Creative's math says a $35 lead that books a $125 quarterly plan returns $500 in year one and $1,500 over three years.
facts.quote: Cube Creative’s math: a $35 lead that books a $125 quarterly plan returns $500 in year one and $1,500 over three years.

facts.fact: PipelineOn, summarizing a 2025 NPMA and PCO Bookkeepers cost study, reports recurring revenue is 74% of pest control income.
facts.quote: reports that recurring revenue is 74% of pest control income.

facts.fact: Cube Creative says when half of busy-season calls reach voicemail, cost per booked customer doubles.
facts.quote: when half of busy-season calls reach voicemail, cost per booked customer doubles.

facts.fact: Elevarus suggests moving 20% to 30% of the budget to Search during fall rodent season, as an agency view.
facts.quote: It suggests moving 20% to 30% of the budget to Search then

facts.fact: Search Engine Roundtable reported on February 11, 2025 that local advertisers said Local Services Ads lead quality had dropped.
facts.quote: reported on February 11, 2025, that local advertisers said lead quality had dropped.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital's method recommends a 30-minute weekly call review to show which of the six problems costs the most.
facts.quote: A 30-minute weekly call review

facts.fact: Cube Creative lists a valid Local Services Ads lead as an answered call, text, voicemail or booking request.
facts.quote: lists a valid lead as an answered call, text, voicemail or booking request.

facts.fact: The Built-Right Digital call-tag table lists six call tags, each pointing to a setting to change.
facts.quote: Six call tags and the setting each one points to.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital's method suggests blocking 30 minutes each week to tag every call from the past seven days.
facts.quote: Block 30 minutes each week, tag every call from the past seven days

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital's rule of thumb (not a Google figure) is to add Search ads when the same off-target tag tops the weekly review two weeks in a row.
facts.quote: Add Search when the same off-target tag tops your weekly review two weeks in a row.

facts.fact: Google does not credit leads for wrong job or wrong area, according to the article.
facts.quote: Google does not credit wrong job or wrong area

facts.fact: Google has dropped credits for 'job type not serviced' and 'geo not serviced' leads, while its automated system can still credit leads it later judges poor.
facts.quote: Google has dropped credits for “job type not serviced” and “geo not serviced” leads

facts.fact: Cube Creative says most pest control companies see between 15 and 60 Local Services Ads leads a month, varying with season and competition.
facts.quote: Cube Creative says most pest control companies see between 15 and 60 leads a month

facts.fact: Elevarus puts the headline cost of a pest control Local Services Ads lead at about $18 to $45 in 2026, based on operator-reported ranges.
facts.quote: Elevarus puts headline cost at about $18 to $45 a lead in 2026, based on operator-reported ranges.

facts.fact: The article recommends logging cost per booked job once a month.
facts.quote: log cost per booked job once a month
